status: Rules of this pack that a machine can check on a screen, read by the design-audit extension. Each names the rule it comes from (rules.json) and its source. A rule not listed here is still in force: the agent and the delivery notes apply it.

allowCopy.source: kit VPDS Components › Logos › Placeholder logo: the Community kit ships no Visa logo, so every navigation and footer shows the kit's placeholder; declared as a gap in the notes of each build

checks.title: One primary button per screen
checks.source: design.visa.com › Button › Usage › Primary buttons: one primary button per screen, headers, dialogs, content cards and panels not counted. The audit counts the primary buttons placed on the screen itself; the ones inside library components (a content card, a dialog) are the library's and are not counted.

checks.title: Minimum target size
checks.source: design.visa.com › States › Usage › Interactive target areas: at least 24 x 24 dp on non-touch screens, 44 x 44 on touch screens

checks.title: The footer is on every page
checks.source: design.visa.com › Footer › Best practices: the footer appears the same on every page where it is used; kit › Application layouts
